summary: Add the external st-fabric-adapter for owner-scoped Fabric runtime peers

rules.detail: st3 does not program Fabric policy. The separate adapter reads verified local membership and leave state and uses Fabric's runtime-peers authority.

compatibility.detail: Requires the local leave-state API and Fabric runtime-peers support enabled with --runtime-peers. Only st/fleet/<fleet-id> runtime records are changed. Static and other-owner grants are never edited.

downtime.detail: The adapter runs separately; deploying it does not restart st3.

manual.detail: Run st-fabric-adapter --once for a single reconciliation, run without --once to poll, and use --status to read the last recorded JSON status. Its service unit is configured separately.

recovery.detail: Keep the adapter-owned state directory across restarts: it stores durable policy receipts, retired peers and known fleet owners. API failures do not become empty membership; expired leave grace never retains a carrier.
